kevin: Morning quick check — what I did: pushed hotfix for canary rollback (PR #4321) and ran smoke tests. Blockers: backport for release-1.4 failing unit tests on kv-cache (see snippet below). Today: monitor canary, land 3 backports, and coordinate GPU pool swap if needed.

anita: Thanks — can you paste failing test log?

kevin: Sure:
```
FAIL tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_prefix_cache - AssertionError: expected 1024 got 1008
Trace: ...
```

mike: I can take the backport for #4323 this morning. Ping me on the PR.

sarah: FYI I did a quick perf run — canary latency stable at 55-60ms p50, p95 ~180ms. No regressions.

ci-bot: Build status: backport-4323: flaky (2/4), backport-4330: passing, backport-4332: failing lint

kevin: @mike awesome. @anita can you help with the kv-cache test? might be flaky from quantized run.

anita: On it. I'll try reproducing locally and open a debug gist.

ops-bot: Heads-up: GPU pool maintenance scheduled 09:00-09:30 UTC. Autoscaler will drain nodes; plan to shift canary to reserve pool during that window.

kevin: Noted — I'll coordinate the short swap. @sarah please keep an eye on canary traces during 09:00.

sarah: Will do. I'll post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:

mike: PR pinged: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4323 - assigned to me, will target cutline-1.4 branch.

kevin: Great. If anything blocks, escalate here. Otherwise I'll post a final status after 11:00 UTC.

anita: Gist with failing logs: https://gist.github.com/anita/abcd1234 — debugging now.

kevin: Thanks team. Minimal noise, keep this thread for the cutline updates.
